info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Balances-v2-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Balance Retrieval API allows consumers to access the current loyalty balances associated with user accounts. This endpoint is essential for loyalty program management, enabling businesses to provide users with real-time information about their accumulated rewards. Typical use cases include displaying balance information within mobile apps or web platforms where customers can track their loyalty points. The API ensures that users have an up-to-date view of their loyalty status, fostering engagement and satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current loyalty balance of a user. It provides essential information regarding the points or rewards a user has accumulated through previous interactions.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the loyalty balance. This request requires no additional parameters and is designed to fetch the current balance of the user's loyalty account.
